evals.prompt: Add mail.acme.com as a sending domain in Emailit and tell me what DNS records to add.
evals.expected_output: Creates the domain and lists the MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records exactly as returned by Emailit.
expectations: Lists records from the response rather than invented values
Marks DMARC, tracking, and inbound as optional

evals.prompt: My domain shows SPF failed in Emailit. Help.
evals.expected_output: Reads the domain record errors and explains the exact SPF value on the emailit subdomain.
expectations: Calls get-domain to read the SPF status and error
Gives v=spf1 include:_spf.emailit.com ~all on the emailit. host

evals.prompt: Turn on click tracking for my new Emailit domain right now.
evals.expected_output: Explains the go CNAME must verify first and does not pass tracking flags before it does.
expectations: Mentions the go CNAME record to go.emailitmail.com
Does not call create-domain or update-domain with tracking before the CNAME verifies
